profile.name: Harish Kumar T N
profile.headline: Harish Kumar T N · code, markets, badminton & trips
profile.description: Hi, I'm Harish. This is my little corner of the internet: what I'm building, what I'm learning about markets, badminton clips and trips with friends.
about: I'm Harish Kumar T N. I used to write data pipelines for a living, and these days I'm at IIT Madras doing an MS in Entrepreneurship and heading pre-incubation at CIFIL.
Outside of that, you'll usually find me on a badminton court (pretty much every day), planning the next trip with friends, or reading about how markets work.
Somewhere down the line I want to do a PhD in fintech at UCL. This site is where I keep track of it all.
profile.dream: A PhD in fintech at the UCL Institute of Finance & Technology (IFT).

experience.summary: Heading pre-incubation at CIFIL, IIT Madras.
Started as an intern and stayed on as an Associate Software Engineer, mostly on the data side.
highlights: Built data engineering ETL pipelines with Spark, Airflow, Kafka and AWS.
Built an internal DevOps portal in React and Go.

education.school: Department of Management Studies (DoMS), IIT Madras
